::: {#exm-dfs-connected}
#### Is the office still connected?

`dfs` (@def-dfs) from $a$ marks all six vertices of the office graph (@sol-follow-first),
so the office graph is connected, by @cor-dfs-connected.
In the graph $H$ of @exr-cut-cables, `dfs` from $a$ marks only $a$, $b$ and $c$,
so $H$ is not connected, as @sol-cut-cables found by hand.
@thm-bfs-distance shows that `bfs` (@def-bfs) marks the same vertices as `dfs`,
so `bfs` can test connectedness too.

:::
